title: Grateful Dead Live at Market Square Arena on 1979-02-03
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture, but the classic China Cat → I Know You Rider segue is absent, making the show feel incomplete.
ai_review.review: The recording quality is praised as clear and well‑captured, likely a soundboard source. However fans are disappointed that the expected China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider sequence is missing, leaving only two repetitions of I Know You Rider in its place.

ai_rating.rationale: One review gives a moderate 3‑star rating; it praises the audio but criticizes the setlist omission, resulting in an average overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a great recording and notes no sound issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is marred by the absence of the classic China Cat > Rider transition, resulting in a less satisfying flow despite solid playing.
